content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30+ reps per set, as long as your sets finish close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank). Heavier loads (5-10 reps) are more time-efficient and build strength faster. 💪

For your 100 kg bench goal, you do need heavy work, because strength is a skill you have to practice. A good mix is heavy sets of 3-6 reps on your main lifts, plus moderate 8-15 rep sets for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
